project_context.description: A premium web utility application for YouTube creators. It provides tools for SEO analysis, Title generation, Tag extraction, and Revenue calculation.
project_context.target_audience: YouTube Content Creators in Tier 1 countries (USA, UK, Canada).
project_context.monetization_focus: High RPM Google AdSense. Requires fast load times, professional English copy, and built-in SEO rich text.

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS (Utility classes mapped to Jaspr HTML components)

vibe_and_design_system.typography: Inter or standard sans-serif. Clean, highly legible, professional tone.

animations.tab_switch: animate-fade-up (custom CSS keyframe: translateY 15px to 0, opacity 0 to 1, duration 400ms)
animations.results_load: animate-scale-in (custom CSS keyframe: scale 0.9 to 1.05 to 1, duration 500ms)

ux_rules: No alerts or native popups. Use smooth inline error states.
Mobile-first: Large touch targets for buttons (py-4) and inputs (py-3).
Tab system must not reload the page (SPA behavior).

features.output: 0-100 Score circular indicator. Color coded (Green > 75, Yellow otherwise). List of passed/failed feedback points.
List of 4 highly clickable titles with mock CTR scores.
Estimated monthly revenue range in USD based on Tier 1 RPMs.

seo_and_content_strategy.structure: A beautifully styled informational article titled 'The Ultimate Guide to YouTube Monetization & Growth'.

generation_instructions: Act as a Senior Dart/Jaspr & Python developer. Generate the complete `app.dart` utilizing Jaspr's specific HTML syntax `div(classes: '...', [text('...')])`. Ensure the `http` package is used for API calls. Include the custom CSS for animations in a separate block. Ensure the Python FastAPI code matches the exact payload structures expected by the Jaspr frontend.
